raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #46067. The model gateway enables `TCP_NODELAY` on worker connections, but accepted client sockets still use the default acceptor. Small streaming responses can therefore incur Nagle/delayed-ACK stalls, including a roughly 40 ms delay observed locally over HTTPS.

## Modifications

- Use axum-server's existing `NoDelayAcceptor` for accepted HTTP connections.
- Compose `NoDelayAcceptor` inside `RustlsAcceptor` for HTTPS, setting the socket option before the TLS handshake.
- Document the behavior in the gateway README.

This keeps the existing bind, shutdown, and TLS configuration paths and adds no dependency or configuration option. #33269 addressed the separate `rust/sglang-server` implementation; it did not change this gateway. I checked open PRs referencing #46067 and `TCP_NODELAY` and found no overlapping gateway fix.

## Accuracy Tests

No model or sampling code changes. A local mock worker streamed two content chunks (`Hello`, ` world`) followed by `[DONE]` through the real compiled gateway. Both versions passed HTTP status and complete SSE-content checks for all 24 requests: 4 connections per protocol, 3 requests per connection, over HTTP and self-signed HTTPS.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Ubuntu 24.04 under WSL2; debug gateway builds; loopback mock worker; 5 ms simulated token intervals. The client disabled `TCP_QUICKACK` to expose delayed ACKs. `strace -f -yy -e trace=accept4,setsockopt` associated each accepted client socket with its `TCP_NODELAY` call.

| Check | Main (`02b983603d34`) | This change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HTTP client connections with `TCP_NODELAY=1` | 0 / 4 | 4 / 4 |
| HTTPS client connections with `TCP_NODELAY=1` | 0 / 4 | 4 / 4 |
| SSE responses passing content checks | 24 / 24 | 24 / 24 |
| HTTPS first-event latency on fresh connections (4 samples, range) | 41.69–45.36 ms | 1.92–2.95 ms |

These timings are a transport smoke test under tracing, not a model-inference benchmark or throughput claim. HTTP did not reproduce a 40 ms stall in this run; its socket-option check still failed before the change and passed afterward.

Build and lint checks passed:

```bash
cd sgl-model-gateway
cargo +1.90.0 build --bin smg
cargo +1.90.0 clippy --bin smg -- -D warnings
cargo +nightly fmt -- --check
cd ..
pre-commit run --files sgl-model-gateway/src/server.rs sgl-model-gateway/README.md
git diff --check
```

The pre-commit run used a Linux-filesystem copy of the source to avoid WSL mounted-filesystem latency; both changed files were checked byte-for-byte against the submitted files afterward. Build and streaming checks used the working checkout directly.

The socket check can also be repeated against an existing streaming worker:

```bash
strace -f -yy -e trace=accept4,setsockopt -o gateway.strace \
  target/debug/smg launch --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000 \
  --worker-urls http://127.0.0.1:8000
```

Send streaming `/v1/chat/completions` requests, then verify `TCP_NODELAY=1` on the accepted client sockets, not only the outgoing worker sockets. Repeat with `--tls-cert-path` and `--tls-key-path` for HTTPS.

AI assistance was used to investigate, implement, and run local validation for this change.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). No new unit test: this wires the library's existing acceptors; validation above exercises actual sockets and proxied SSE on both serving paths.
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Transport results are above; no model accuracy or throughput benchmark was run.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

 Both parameters must be provided together. The gateway uses rustls with the ring crypto provider for TLS termination. If TLS is not configured, the gateway falls back to plain HTTP.
